paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar bar Avina; his son-in-law Menachem (see there). Yevamot 63a: ben Avinai [the checked text reads Elazar bar Avina], “Calamities come only because of Israel.” Berakhot 4b: “Eliezer said in Avina’s name, Whoever says A Psalm of David,” [the checked Bavli gives Elazar here] etc., is an error for Elazar bar Avina, as Ein Yaakov and the end of that page; new editions did not correct it. Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 1, mishnah 8: bar Avina.
